title: Market-cushion failure-proximity conditioning: liabilities vs price-transmitted market equity, on the death-inclusive cohort (Campbell-Hilscher OME / Shumway leverage lineage)
mechanism: Who is forced to buy/sell: mandate-constrained institutional holders are forced sellers only AFTER a name's equity cushion has visibly collapsed (rating floors, mandate screens, index-committee rules trigger on broken prices and impaired balance sheets), so their exit flow arrives late and in size into thinning liquidity; on the other side, lottery-preferring retail buyers systematically overweight small, cheap, high-leverage names whose payoffs resemble lottery tickets, and they do so precisely when the equity option is far out of the money. Why the effect exists: in the Merton/Shumway/Campbell-Hilscher frame, equity is a call option on assets struck at liabilities; Campbell-Hilscher (2008) show that market-value leverage (their out-of-the-money-ness measure, total liabilities / market assets) is the single most informative failure-probability characteristic, and that firms near failure earn significantly LOWER subsequent returns - investors underprice failure risk because distressed names' returns are skewed and extrapolation errors are largest exactly in the tail. The death-inclusive cohort is what makes this observable honest: the short tail is populated by names that actually died and their delisting returns are carried by the price series instead of vanishing (a survivor panel cannot express this book). Which observable measures it: the market-cushion distance s = L / (L + ME), where L is total liabilities from the funded PIT vintage and ME = RAW close at the decision session x the funded filed share count (split-aligned by the frozen corporate-actions module); within-sector terciles of s are formed on the inherited 21-session grid - LOW s (far from failure) is the long leg, HIGH s (nearest failure) is the short leg. When it must fail: (i) if the book-leverage control (same L, no price input) reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x alpha ratio, the effect is generic accounting leverage, not market-transmitted proximity; (ii) if the D2 pre-selection screen measures the anchor rank's Spearman correlation against a 63-session prior-return rank above 0.80, the anchor is a momentum shadow (the V4/V5 pre-selection catch region, rho 0.78-0.83) and is ineligible before selection; (iii) if > 90% of the short-leg expectancy is produced by names whose final bar falls within 21 sessions of entry, the mechanism is terminal death-event mechanics rather than proximity conditioning and the family is not promotable as a proximity mechanism; (iv) the family dies if any inherited Stage-A gate fails per the ex-ante margins below.
falsifiable_prediction: Directional and falsifiable: within-sector terciles of s = L/(L+ME) predict relative returns monotonically over the inherited 21-session decision window - the nearest-failure tercile underperforms the farthest-failure tercile in at least 2 of 3 folds after band costs, with (a) long-short expectancy > 0, (b) position PF >= 1.10, (c) the SHORT leg carrying the majority of the spread (short-leg expectancy <= -0.5x long-leg expectancy; the distress anomaly is a short-side failure-probability premium per Campbell-Hilscher, not a long-side quality premium), (d) risk-matched excess vs SPY positive in >= 2 folds and overall alpha > 0, (e) the book-leverage control (L/(L+SE), no price input) NOT reproducing the anchor: |control alpha| < 0.5x anchor alpha, and the control arm never outperforming the anchor in the anchor's direction, (f) anchor and control ranks not rank-identical (Spearman rho < 0.95 measured pre-selection on the decision grid), and (g) the D2 pre-selection screen reporting Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden-ancestor rank (V2 sector-momentum rank, SFV8-F1/F2 anchor ranks, SFV4 semivariance and participation anchors) and < 0.80 vs the 63-session prior-return rank. If any of (a)-(g) fails, the family is rejected and market-cushion failure proximity is declared untradable on this cohort at these costs.

legs: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410 members, frozen V8 panel, cohort_v9.json)

DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550 members, p0d integrity-scan confirmed; dead names are REQUIRED for this mechanism - they populate the nearest-failure tail and their delisting returns are carried by the price series)
eligibility_floor_inherited: member of the two cohort legs above
>= 63 price bars through the decision session (inherited floor; also the ADV63 window)
ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better) at the decision; band D is UNTRADABLE_AT_DECISION and excluded
RAW close >= 1.00 USD at the decision (sub-dollar microstructure exclusion)
signal populated: funded vintages available for every cited field under the clocks below (market-cushion rank requires L and shares within bounds plus a bar at the decision session)
universe.sector_conditioning: sector-neutral tercile books on the frozen SIC->SPDR sector tag carried in the cohort/panel (cohort_v9.json sector_rule: empirical majority map; UNMAPPED sectors are never guessed and abstain); sectors with fewer than 6 ranked names abstain that decision (inherited runner rule); equal-weight 0.5 long / 0.5 short inside each active sector, CASH absorbs the net

clock.citation_rule: only clocks in p2_v9_coverage_first.json dead_leg_funded_clocks.clocks (56 clocks, 33 fields) are cited, verbatim as {field, max_age_days} pairs; the price leg is authorized separately for every cohort member (p0d manifest); nothing else is legal
clock.staleness_rule_declared_ex_ante: every fundamental input uses the 800-day bounded funded clock, never the unbounded (null) variant; rationale declared before any scoring: on a death-inclusive cohort, an unbounded clock lets the AGE of the last filing itself become the ranking variable (delinquent filers are disproportionately dying filers), producing a vintage-age shadow rather than the proximity mechanism; the 800-day bound is the only funded alternative

cited_funded_clocks.role: anchor and neighbour market-equity construction (share count; split-aligned to the decision session via the frozen corporate-actions module; unit stamp 'shares', not USD - the loader must admit the field's own unit and fail closed otherwise)
neighbour market-assets bridge (Assets - SE + ME); control denominator (L + SE)
neighbour numerator (cash cushion vs market assets)

market_leg_inputs: RAW close at the decision session (eligibility, price floor, and ME construction; RAW series primary per V6 corporate-actions policy)
ME = RAW_close(decision session) x split-aligned funded share count; dividends never enter ME
clock.as_of_semantics: inherited V6 multi-vintage as-of: for a decision at session t, a field observes its latest filed vintage with avail < gate(t) (gate = 00:00 UTC of the decision session) and age <= 800 days; NEVER the latest vintage in the store

warmup_decisions.justification: all three arms are LEVEL arms (no YoY delta legs), so no prior-year reference is needed; the inherited F2 precedent used 0 warmup decisions for level arms (v8_family_runner.py ARM_SPECS SFV8-F2-*); the 63-bar eligibility floor is the only warmup requirement

decision_grid.grid: inherited 21-session grid, unchanged: per-fold local indices 63 + 21k, strictly inside each fold; folds forced flat at boundaries with cost
decision_grid.deviation: none - denominator compatibility with the 21 prior scored cells requires the inherited grid; no deviation is proposed

entry_exit_fills.entry: signals computed on session t close data (PIT gate = 00:00 UTC t); fills at the next global session close; no same-session fill (inherited fill clock)
entry_exit_fills.fill_check_preregistered: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; a missing bar means the order does not exist - no silent substitute pricing (p3 v9_additions.dead_name_book_semantics_PREREGISTERED)
entry_exit_fills.exit_preregistered: a held name whose series ends is exited at its LAST recorded close on its final session; the delisting return is carried by the price series itself - no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation (p3 dead-name book semantics)
entry_exit_fills.no_survivorship_resubstitution: a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series (p3 forbidden clause); books re-form only at decision sessions from the surviving-eligible set, never by substitution
entry_exit_fills.weights: inherited: equal-weight within legs, 1/n_active allocation per sector, 0.5 long / 0.5 short per active sector, CASH absorbs residual; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision, min 30 scored decisions overall, min 5 scored decisions per fold
entry_exit_fills.hysteresis: one-decile retention hysteresis on book membership (inherited runner rule) to keep turnover inside the frozen 6.0x/yr ceiling
entry_exit_fills.implementation_feasibility_note: the V8 runner's missing-price-leg skip (v8_family_runner.py run_arm: 'if fi is None or ei is None ... continue') must be replaced by the preregistered exit-at-last-close semantics for the dead leg; this is the single bounded kernel change this family requires, and the fail-closed band resolution (L-I3) already raises BandResolutionError rather than defaulting bands

band_model_inherited.status: UNTRADABLE_AT_DECISION - excluded from eligibility at that decision

costs.charging: linear in fills (L-V14-0), charged exactly once per fill on traded notional, applied to booked PnL (never a sidecar); band from the trailing 63-session median dollar volume as of the decision (PIT); fail-closed band resolution (L-I3): a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError
costs.stress: stress rerun at the stress bps above (20/30/50 per side); stress must remain positive on PnL with PF >= 1.0
costs.turnover_ceiling: 6.0 two-way per year, annualized, raw and ceiling-normalized both reported

arms.score: s = L / (L + ME); ME = RAW_close(t) x split-aligned funded share count
arms.direction: low_long (LOW s = far from failure = long; HIGH s = nearest failure = short)
arms.data_space: {Liabilities vintage} x {share-count vintage} x {daily RAW price}

arms.role: neighbour (adjacent form supporting the market-assets proximity frame)
arms.score: cash_to_market_assets = Cash / (Assets - SE + ME)  [Campbell-Hilscher CASHMTA form]
arms.direction: high_long (cash-rich relative to market assets = far from failure = long; thin = short)
arms.support_expectation: same sign as the anchor (the market-assets frame, not the specific numerator, carries proximity); if the neighbour flips sign the anchor's effect is numerator-specific and not a proximity mechanism
arms.data_space: {Cash, Assets, SE vintages} x {share-count vintage} x {daily RAW price}

arms.role: causal/placebo control designed to refute the mechanism-specific explanation
arms.direction: low_long (same direction as the anchor for comparability)
arms.mechanism_refuted_if_reproduced: the mechanism claim is that PROXIMITY IS MARKET-TRANSMITTED: the equity cushion is re-priced daily between filings and failure risk prices into returns in real time. If the book-leverage control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x alpha ratio, the information is generic accounting leverage carried by the balance sheet alone and the market-proximity claim is dead (this is the F2 falsification pattern: a bloat/level shadow, not the mechanism)
arms.differs_from_anchor_in_data_space: the control has ZERO price-leg inputs and ZERO share-count inputs - it is a function of two slow-moving book quantities only, while the anchor's ranks move daily with price between filings through ME; the two ranks are constructed from disjoint input spaces (anchor: L + shares + price; control: L + SE) and are declared not rank-identical (rho < 0.95 required pre-selection, measured on the decision grid); the V4/V5 lesson (rho 0.78-0.83 caught pre-selection) is honored by measuring this correlation at D2 before any selection

margin_to_fail_expectations.reporting_authority: LESSONS P-2 and p3 v8_additions.margin_to_fail_reporting: every gate on a surviving family reports distance to its failure threshold, ex ante declared here

gates_ex_ante.ex_ante_expectation: positive but THIN: distress short-side premia net of band-C costs are historically small per decision; margin expected < 0.05 per decision; a knife-edge pass must be treated as fragile per P-2
the anomaly should not be single-fold (it is a slow characteristic, not an event); margin expected >= 1 fold
no fold may be deep-negative; expected margin > 0.0
a sector-neutral 0.5L/0.5S book with ~0 net should sit well inside the ceiling; expected margin > 0.05; failure here means the book is carrying hidden net beta
SPY-excess positive in >= 2 folds - beta alone is the V2 lesson and cannot pass

gates_ex_ante.ex_ante_note: packet-level gate per the D1 brief; the p3-frozen scoring gate etf_positive_share_le = 0.35 also binds unchanged, so the expectation is stated against the TIGHTER frozen 0.35: sector-neutral tercile books with 0.5L/0.5S per sector are constructed so ETF-positive share stays far below 0.35; a fail here is a book-construction bug, not a signal property

gates_ex_ante.definition: PnL > 0 and PF >= 1.0 at stress multipliers (20/30/50 bps)
gates_ex_ante.ex_ante_expectation: the short-leg spread must survive doubled costs; margin expected thin - this is the gate most likely to fail honestly

gates_ex_ante.definition: value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol: post-drop expectancy > 0; and min over folds with that fold removed > 0
gates_ex_ante.ex_ante_expectation: with ~1960 cohort names and sector-neutral terciles, single-name concentration should be low; expected margin large

gates_ex_ante.definition: control_alpha_abs_ratio < 0.5 AND the control never outperforms the anchor in the anchor's direction (a control that outperforms a negative anchor falsifies the family - inherited causal_control_rule)
gates_ex_ante.ex_ante_expectation: book leverage and market leverage are correlated but distinct; the expectation is a control ratio in the 0.1-0.4 band - if it lands >= 0.5 the mechanism is falsified honestly

pre_selection_screens_d2: Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden-ancestor rank (V2 sector momentum, SFV8-F1 anchor, SFV8-F2 anchor, SFV4 semivariance anchor, SFV4 participation anchor)
Spearman rho vs 63-session prior-return rank < 0.80 (momentum-shadow bar, V4 pre-selection catch precedent)
a measured violation of any screen makes this proposal INELIGIBLE before selection - never argued in prose
margin_to_fail_expectations.falsification_fires_when: any inherited gate fails on the anchor, OR the control reproduces >= 0.5x, OR the control outperforms a negative anchor, OR > 90% of short-leg expectancy comes from terminal-window exits (<= 21 sessions to final bar)

could_be_confused_with.ancestor: SFV8-F1 WC-ACCRUAL-FLOW (V8) and its WC stock-level exposure shadow
could_be_confused_with.concrete_design_difference: F1 ranks working-capital ACCRUAL flow/stock built from AR + INV - AP over Assets (earnings-fixation mispricing); H1 ranks market-value leverage from Liabilities and price x shares (failure proximity). No shared mechanism construct and no shared fields (the only field overlap anywhere in the packet is Assets, and only as a bridge term in the neighbour's market-assets definition, never in the anchor); H1 computes no deltas of WC items and makes no accrual-persistence claim

could_be_confused_with.ancestor: SFV8-F2 DEP-RESERVE-COVERAGE (V8) and the Goodwill/Assets bloat shadow
could_be_confused_with.concrete_design_difference: F2 ranks AccumulatedDepreciation/PP&E (and its Goodwill/Assets shadow) - a conservatism/bloat construct; H1 uses neither field and makes no conservatism or asset-quality claim

could_be_confused_with.ancestor: SFV4-A4-H1 SEMIVARIANCE-SHARE and the measured vol-level shadow
could_be_confused_with.concrete_design_difference: H1 has no return-distribution input: no variance, downside or total, is computed anywhere in the arm; vol-level sorting is not reachable from {Liabilities, shares, price-level} inputs

could_be_confused_with.ancestor: SFV4-A5-H1 PARTICIPATION-SHIFT and the sector-exposure shadow
could_be_confused_with.concrete_design_difference: H1 has no dollar-volume shock ratio and no participation construct; volume enters only through the inherited ADV63 eligibility band, never through the rank; sector exposure is neutralized by construction (0.5L/0.5S per sector)

could_be_confused_with.ancestor: A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM (V2) and generic cross-sectional momentum (any lookback/top-K)
could_be_confused_with.concrete_design_difference: H1's only price input is a LEVEL multiplied by shares (market equity), never a return sort; the rank is scaled by a slow book quantity (Liabilities), so it is not a momentum rank by construction; because market leverage still correlates mechanically with prior price declines, the momentum confound is handled by a PREREGISTERED pre-selection bar: D2 must measure the anchor rank's Spearman correlation vs the 63-session prior-return rank, and >= 0.80 makes the proposal ineligible as a momentum shadow (the V4/V5 rho 0.78-0.83 catch region); ancestral novelty gates (|rho| <= 0.20 vs V2 and all forbidden-ancestor ranks) apply unchanged at D2
price enters H1 as a market-cap construction, never as a nominal price level; the RAW >= 1.00 floor is inherited eligibility applied identically to every arm, not a conditioning variable

could_be_confused_with.ancestor: death-event structure (PLAN axis 3, post-Form-15 drift / delisting-return structure)
could_be_confused_with.concrete_design_difference: H1 conditions on a PIT cross-sectional distress rank formed at ordinary decision sessions across alive AND dying names - it never references death dates, Form 15 filings, or calendar proximity to delisting; the terminal-window concentration clause in the falsifiable prediction exists precisely to catch and reject any slide into death-event mechanics

novelty_declaration.lineage_statement: the mechanism is new to this factory: Shumway (2001) hazard conditioning (leverage and size), Campbell-Hilscher (2008) out-of-the-money-ness (total liabilities / market assets), Merton (1974) distance-to-default - none of these constructs appear anywhere in the cumulative forbidden inventory, and the death-inclusive universe is what makes the short tail expressible
novelty_declaration.measured_decorrelation_required: |rho| <= 0.20 pooled vs every forbidden ancestor per plan section 1, measured at D2 before selection; the anchor-vs-own-control correlation is allowed to be nonzero (they share Liabilities) but must be < 0.95 (not rank-identical)
